_comment: APRAS-68. The contrast ratio, pinned from BOTH sides: tests/test_branding.py::test_the_shared_fixture_matches_the_python_helper asserts these numbers against app/core/branding.py, and frontend/src/lib/__tests__/contrast.test.ts asserts the same file against frontend/src/lib/contrast.ts. Neither language may import the other, so the file is the contract. The out-of-gamut cases are load-bearing: a port that clips per channel where the browser reduces chroma (CSS Color 4 section 13) gets 4.52 where this file says 3.74 and fails.

cases.name: the shipped index.css muted pair, which reads 10.96 under a double sRGB transfer
black on white is the maximum
out of gamut: measured 4.52 by a naive clip, painted 3.74 by the browser
